characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack that does not hit, you may assign 1 focus token to your ship.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Enemy ships with a pilot skill value lower than yours cannot declare you as the target of an attack. After you perform an attack or when you are the only remaining friendly ship in play, discard this card.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Activation phase, you may discard this card to treat each friendly ship's pilot skill value as "12" until the end of the phase.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Planning phase, you may choose an enemy ship at Range 1-2. Guess aloud that ship's bearing and speed, then look at its dial. If you are correct, you may rotate your dial to another maneuver.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When you are dealt a damage card, you may immediately discard that card and recover 1 shield. Then, discard this upgrade card.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: You may perform attacks while overlapping an obstacle. Your attacks cannot be obstructed.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When you perform a coordinate action, you may choose 2 friendly ships (instead of 1). Those ships may each perform 1 free action.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When performing a jam action, you may choose an enemy ship at Range 1-3 (instead of at Range 1-2).

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if you are stressed, you may change 1 of your [focus] results to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking with a primary weapon or defending, if the enemy ship is inside your firing arc, you may add 1 blank result to your roll.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Equip the Phantom title card to a friendly Attack Shuttle and dock it to this ship. After you execute a maneuver, you may deploy it from your rear guides.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if you have a target lock on the defender, you may spend that target lock to change all of your [focus] results to [hit] results.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: You can reveal and execute red maneuvers even while you are stressed.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, once per attack, if you are dealt a faceup Damage card, you may discard it and draw another faceup Damage card.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When another friendly ship at Range 1 is attacking, it may change 1 of its [hit] results to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, when a friendly ship at Range 1-3 performs a focus action or would be assigned a focus token, you may assign that ship an evade token instead.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Choose 1 friendly ship at Range 1-2. Assign 1 focus token to that ship for each enemy ship inside your firing arc at Range 1-3. You cannot assign more than 3 tokens in this way.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, after a friendly ship at Range 1-2 executes a white maneuver, you may remove 1 stress token from that ship.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After you remove a stress token from your ship, you may assign a focus token to your ship.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Roll 2 defense dice. For each [focus] result, assign 1 focus token to your ship. For each [evade] result, assign 1 evade token to your ship.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Activation phase, you may discard this card to allow all friendly ships that reveal a red maneuver to treat that maneuver as a white maneuver until the end of the phase.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack that does not hit, you may immediately perform a primary weapon attack. You may change 1 [focus] result to a [hit] result. You cannot perform another attack this round.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: When a ship you have locked is attacking, you may choose 1 attack die. The attacker must reroll that die. You can acquire target locks on other friendly ships.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your action bar gains the [evade] action icon.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a 3-speed bank maneuver ([left bank] or [right bank]), if you are not touching another ship and you are not stressed, you may receive 1 stress token to rotate your ship 180°.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: You may treat all [straight] maneuvers as green maneuvers.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: While you have a [cannon] Upgrade card equipped, you cannot perform primary weapon attacks and you may perform [cannon] secondary weapon attacks against ships outside your firing arc.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: While you are docked, the Ghost can perform primary weapon attacks from its special firing arc and, at the end of the combat phase, it may perform an additional attack with an equipped [turret]. If it performs this attack, it cannot attack again this round.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the End phase, if you have 1 or fewer energy tokens, gain 1 energy token.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: After executing a green maneuver, you may recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of the End phase, if you have no shields, you may recover 1 shield and roll 1 attack die. On a [hit] result, randomly flip 1 of your facedown Damage cards faceup and resolve it.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [elite] upgrade icon.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Increase your agility value by 1 until the end of this game round.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: When you declare the target of your attack, if the defender is inside your firing arc, you may receive 1 stress token to cause the defender to receive 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: When you are hit by an attack and there are at least 3 uncancelled [hit] results, you may choose and cancel those results until there are 2 remaining. For each result cancelled in this way, receive 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Roll 1 defense die. On a [evade] or [focus] result, discard 1 of your facedown Damage cards.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: After spending your target lock, roll 1 defense die. On a [evade] result, immediately acquire a target lock on that same ship. You cannot spend this target lock during this attack.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Combat phase, you may spend 1 of your focus tokens to recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal your maneuver, you may discard this card to ignore obstacles until the end of the round.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Choose an enemy ship at Range 1-2. If you are inside that ship's firing arc, you may acquire a target lock on that ship. Then, you may perform a free boost action.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Activation phase, choose 1 enemy ship at Range 1-3. You may look at that ship's chosen maneuver. If the maneuver is white, assign that ship 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the End phase, you may place 1 of your ship's focus tokens on this card. At the start of the Combat phase, you may assign 1 of those tokens to your ship.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [bomb] icon. Once per turn, before a friendly bomb token is removed, choose 1 enemy ship at Range 1 of that token. That ship suffers 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [crew] and [illicit] upgrade icons.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your fore section upgrade bar gains 1 additional [crew] and 1 additional [team] upgrade icon.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Spend any amount of energy to choose that many enemy ships at Range 1-2. Remove all focus, evade, and blue target lock tokens from those ships.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack that does not hit, you may perform a primary weapon attack against a different ship. You cannot perform another attack this round.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When you acquire a target lock, you can lock onto an enemy ship at Range 1-3 of any friendly ship.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking at Range 1-2, you may change 1 of your [hit] results to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, you may reroll your [focus] results.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When a friendly ship at Range 1 is hit by an attack, you may discard this card to suffer all uncanceled [hit] results instead of the target ship.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Equip the Phantom II title card to a friendly Sheathipede-class shuttle and dock it to this ship. After you execute a maneuver, you may deploy it from your rear guides.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: While you are docked, the Ghost can perform primary weapon attacks from its special firing arc. While you are docked, at the end of the Activation phase, the Ghost may perform a free coordinate action.

characteristics.name: Bomb Ability
characteristics.$text: When you equip this card, place 3 ordnance tokens on each other equipped [bomb] Upgrade card. When you are instructed to discard an Upgrade card, you may discard 1 ordnance token on that card instead.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Discard 1 other equipped Upgrade card to recover 1 shield.

characteristics.name: Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: You cannot attack ships outside your firing arc. After you execute a maneuver, if you did not overlap a ship or obstacle and there are no enemy ships inside your firing arc at Range 1-3, you may perform a free boost or barrel roll action.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, if there is at least 1 other friendly Resistance ship at Range 1-2 of the attacker, you may add 1 [focus] result to your roll.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: When a friendly bomb detonates, you may choose not to suffer its effects. If you do, roll an attack die. On a [hit] result, discard this card.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, you may suffer 1 damage to change all of your [focus] results to [critical] results.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Dual card. Reduce your primary attack value by 1. Your action bar gains [boost]. Treat your [left bank 2] and [right bank 2] maneuvers as green. At the start of the Activation phase, you may flip this card.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Dual card. Your action bar gains [barrel roll]. If you are not stressed, when you reveal a [left turn 3] or [right turn 3] maneuver, you may treat it as a red [left Tallon Roll 3] or [right Tallon Roll 3] in the same direction. At the start of the Activation phase, you may flip this card.

characteristics.name: Torpedoes Ability
characteristics.$text: You may equip up to 2 different Modification upgrades. The squad point cost of each of your equipped [elite] upgrades is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After defending, you may acquire a target lock on the attacker.
